title.pinyin: Gěi zhù zài sùshè de tóngxué
title.english: To everyone living in the dorm

text.traditional:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房間門口和樓梯上，請大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房間門口。
二、每天晚上十點以前，請把垃圾拿到一樓的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九點，大家一起打掃樓梯。
text.simplified:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房间门口和楼梯上，请大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房间门口。
二、每天晚上十点以前，请把垃圾拿到一楼的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九点，大家一起打扫楼梯。
text.pinyin:
Zuìjìn chángcháng yǒu rén bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu hé lóutī shàng, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì:
Yī, búyào bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu.
Èr, měi tiān wǎnshàng shí diǎn yǐqián, qǐng bǎ lèsè ná dào yī lóu de lèsè tǒng.
Sān, xīngqíliù zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn, dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo lóutī.
text.english:
Lately people keep leaving garbage at their room doors and on the stairs. Please note:
1. Don't leave garbage at your room door.
2. Every evening before ten, please take your garbage to the trash cans on the first floor.
3. Saturday at 9 a.m., everyone cleans the stairs together.

prompt.traditional: 住在宿舍的同學，晚上應該怎麼做？

passage.traditional: 開學以後，我每天都很忙，已經兩個星期沒打掃房間了。我的房間裡{1}都是書和衣服，桌子上還有沒吃完的東西。昨天晚上，我在床上看見了兩隻{2}，真不舒服。媽媽以前常常告訴我，房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人{3}會覺得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把髒衣服都{4}了，再把地掃一掃。
passage.simplified: 开学以后，我每天都很忙，已经两个星期没打扫房间了。我的房间里{1}都是书和衣服，桌子上还有没吃完的东西。昨天晚上，我在床上看见了两只{2}，真不舒服。妈妈以前常常告诉我，房间要每天打扫，住在里面的人{3}会觉得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把脏衣服都{4}了，再把地扫一扫。
passage.pinyin: Kāixué yǐhòu, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le. Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ dàochù dōu shì shū hé yīfu, zhuōzi shàng hái yǒu méi chī wán de dōngxi. Zuótiān wǎnshàng, wǒ zài chuáng shàng kànjiàn le liǎng zhī chóngzi, zhēn bù shūfu. Māma yǐqián chángcháng gàosu wǒ, fángjiān yào měi tiān dǎsǎo, zhù zài lǐmiàn de rén cái huì juéde shūfu. Suǒyǐ jīntiān wǒ hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng, xiān bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le, zài bǎ dì sǎo yì sǎo.
passage.english: Since school started I've been busy every day, and I haven't cleaned my room for two weeks. There are books and clothes everywhere in my room, and leftover food on the desk. Last night I saw two bugs on my bed, which was really unpleasant. Mom always used to tell me a room should be cleaned every day; only then do the people living in it feel comfortable. So today I got up early, washed all my dirty clothes first, and then swept the floor.

questions.why: 到處都是…: books and clothes are everywhere in the messy room.
兩隻蟲子: 隻 counts animals and bugs, and he saw two of them on his bed.
房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人才會覺得舒服: 才 brings in the result that comes only when the condition is met.
把 + thing + V了: 把髒衣服都洗了, he washed all the dirty clothes before sweeping the floor.

passage.traditional: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花蓮玩了一個星期。回家的時候，一打開門，就覺得味道很{1}。原來出門以前，哥哥忘了把廚房的窗戶{2}了，桌子上的水果也都壞了，到處都是小蟲子。那天晚上，我們{3}都沒吃，大家先一起打掃了兩個小時。媽媽說，下次出門以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡{4}不會有蟲子。
passage.simplified: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花莲玩了一个星期。回家的时候，一打开门，就觉得味道很{1}。原来出门以前，哥哥忘了把厨房的窗户{2}了，桌子上的水果也都坏了，到处都是小虫子。那天晚上，我们{3}都没吃，大家先一起打扫了两个小时。妈妈说，下次出门以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家里{4}不会有虫子。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián shǔjià, wǒ gēn jiārén qù Huālián wán le yí ge xīngqí. Huí jiā de shíhòu, yì dǎkāi mén, jiù juéde wèidào hěn chòu. Yuánlái chūmén yǐqián, gēge wàng le bǎ chúfáng de chuānghù guān le, zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ yě dōu huài le, dàochù dōu shì xiǎo chóngzi. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen shénme dōu méi chī, dàjiā xiān yìqǐ dǎsǎo le liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Māma shuō, xià cì chūmén yǐqián, yídìng yào xiān bǎ zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ chī wán, jiā lǐ cái bú huì yǒu chóngzi.
passage.english: This summer vacation my family and I spent a week in Hualien. When we got home and opened the door, it smelled awful. It turned out that before we left, my older brother had forgotten to close the kitchen window; the fruit on the table had gone bad, and there were little bugs everywhere. That night none of us ate anything; we all cleaned together for two hours first. Mom says next time we have to finish the fruit on the table before we leave; only then won't there be bugs at home.

questions.why: 味道很臭: after a week away, the bad fruit made the house smell awful.
把 + thing + V了: 把窗戶關了, close the window. He forgot to, so bugs came in.
什麼都沒吃: a question word + 都 + 沒 means "nothing at all"; they cleaned before eating anything.
先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡才不會有蟲子: only when the fruit is finished first will there be no bugs.

text.traditional: 昨天弟弟沒去上課，他說他頭很痛，想在家休息。媽媽覺得他可能感冒了，可是他沒發燒，也不咳嗽，晚飯還吃了兩碗，功課也都寫完了。晚上媽媽問了他很久，他才說，他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的。
text.simplified: 昨天弟弟没去上课，他说他头很痛，想在家休息。妈妈觉得他可能感冒了，可是他没发烧，也不咳嗽，晚饭还吃了两碗，功课也都写完了。晚上妈妈问了他很久，他才说，他是因为把同学的小说丢了，才不敢去学校的。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān dìdi méi qù shàngkè, tā shuō tā tóu hěn tòng, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxí. Māma juéde tā kěnéng gǎnmào le, kěshì tā méi fāshāo, yě bù késòu, wǎnfàn hái chī le liǎng wǎn, gōngkè yě dōu xiě wán le. Wǎnshàng māma wèn le tā hěn jiǔ, tā cái shuō, tā shì yīnwèi bǎ tóngxué de xiǎoshuō diū le, cái bù gǎn qù xuéxiào de.
text.english: Yesterday my little brother didn't go to school; he said he had a bad headache and wanted to rest at home. Mom thought he might have a cold, but he had no fever, wasn't coughing, ate two bowls at dinner, and had finished all his homework. In the evening Mom asked him for a long time before he said that he had lost a classmate's novel, and that was the only reason he hadn't dared go to school.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟昨天為什麼沒去上課？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟昨天为什么没去上课？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān wèishénme méi qù shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why didn't the little brother go to school yesterday?

choices.pinyin: Tā de tóu tòng de bù néng qù.
choices.english: His head hurt too much to go.
He had a cold and a fever.

choices.pinyin: Tā de gōngkè hái méi xiě wán.
Tā diū le tóngxué de xiǎoshuō.
choices.english: He had lost a classmate's novel.

questions.why: 他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的: losing a classmate's novel is the real reason. The headache was only his excuse, there was no fever or cough, and his homework was all done.

text.traditional: 我很喜歡看小說，可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放。上個月，我把一些小說送給了對面鄰居的兒子。鄰居說，以前她每天都叫兒子念書，可是他什麼書都不想看。後來是因為看了我送的小說，他才開始喜歡看書。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢看小说，可是房间太小，书太多，没有地方放。上个月，我把一些小说送给了对面邻居的儿子。邻居说，以前她每天都叫儿子念书，可是他什么书都不想看。后来是因为看了我送的小说，他才开始喜欢看书。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xiǎoshuō, kěshì fángjiān tài xiǎo, shū tài duō, méiyǒu dìfāng fàng. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ bǎ yìxiē xiǎoshuō sòng gěi le duìmiàn línjū de érzi. Línjū shuō, yǐqián tā měi tiān dōu jiào érzi niànshū, kěshì tā shénme shū dōu bù xiǎng kàn. Hòulái shì yīnwèi kàn le wǒ sòng de xiǎoshuō, tā cái kāishǐ xǐhuān kàn shū.
text.english: I love reading novels, but my room is too small and I have too many books, so there's nowhere to put them. Last month I gave some novels to my neighbor's son across the hall. My neighbor says she used to tell her son to study every day, but he didn't want to read any book at all. It was only after reading the novels I gave him that he started to like reading.

prompt.traditional: 這個人為什麼把小說送給鄰居的兒子？
prompt.simplified: 这个人为什么把小说送给邻居的儿子？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén wèishénme bǎ xiǎoshuō sòng gěi línjū de érzi?
prompt.english: Why did the writer give novels to the neighbor's son?

choices.traditional: 他的房間沒有地方放書
choices.simplified: 他的房间没有地方放书
choices.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān méiyǒu dìfāng fàng shū.
choices.english: His room has no space for books.

choices.pinyin: Línjū de érzi hěn ài kàn shū.
Línjū qǐng tā sòng yìxiē shū.
choices.english: The neighbor asked him for some books.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bú ài kàn xiǎoshuō le.

questions.why: 可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放: there is no space for the books, so he gave some away. He still loves novels, the neighbor never asked for books, and her son did not like reading at the time (什麼書都不想看).

text.traditional: 我們家有四個人，每個人都得做一件家事：爸爸做飯，媽媽洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做。後來媽媽說，吃飯吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我們都吃得很慢，可是現在大家都吃得很快。
text.simplified: 我们家有四个人，每个人都得做一件家事：爸爸做饭，妈妈洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗这件事，我们谁都不想做。后来妈妈说，吃饭吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我们都吃得很慢，可是现在大家都吃得很快。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu sì ge rén, měi ge rén dōu děi zuò yí jiàn jiāshì: bàba zuò fàn, māma xǐ yīfu, wǒ cā zhuōzi, dìdi dào lèsè. Kěshì xǐ wǎn zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen shéi dōu bù xiǎng zuò. Hòulái māma shuō, chī fàn chī de zuì màn de rén děi xǐ wǎn. Bàba zuò de cài hěn hǎochī, yǐqián wǒmen dōu chī de hěn màn, kěshì xiànzài dàjiā dōu chī de hěn kuài.
text.english: There are four of us at home, and each has one chore: Dad cooks, Mom does the laundry, I wipe the table, and my little brother takes out the garbage. But washing the dishes is something none of us wants to do. Then Mom said the slowest eater has to wash up. Dad's cooking is delicious and we used to eat slowly, but now everyone eats fast.

prompt.traditional: 現在他們家的人為什麼吃飯吃得很快？
prompt.simplified: 现在他们家的人为什么吃饭吃得很快？
prompt.pinyin: Xiànzài tāmen jiā de rén wèishénme chī fàn chī de hěn kuài?
prompt.english: Why does the family eat fast now?

choices.traditional: 他們都不想當洗碗的人
choices.simplified: 他们都不想当洗碗的人
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu bù xiǎng dāng xǐ wǎn de rén.
choices.english: None of them wants to be the one who washes up.

choices.traditional: 他們都很喜歡爸爸做的菜
choices.simplified: 他们都很喜欢爸爸做的菜
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu hěn xǐhuān bàba zuò de cài.

choices.traditional: 他們吃完飯都得做家事
choices.simplified: 他们吃完饭都得做家事
choices.pinyin: Tāmen chī wán fàn dōu děi zuò jiāshì.
choices.english: They all have chores to do after dinner.

choices.traditional: 弟弟吃完飯得去倒垃圾
choices.simplified: 弟弟吃完饭得去倒垃圾
choices.pinyin: Dìdi chī wán fàn děi qù dào lèsè.
choices.english: The little brother has to take out the garbage after dinner.

questions.why: 洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做, and the slowest eater has to wash up, so nobody wants to be last. They do love Dad's cooking, but that is why they used to eat slowly, and nothing says the chores come right after dinner (Dad cooks before it).

text.traditional: 我是從高雄來台北念大學的。開學第一天，我在宿舍誰也不認識，晚飯也不知道要去哪裡吃。後來，住在我對面的同學來找我，帶我去學校附近的夜市。她說那裡的東西什麼都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗湯。現在我們常常一起去吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 我是从高雄来台北念大学的。开学第一天，我在宿舍谁也不认识，晚饭也不知道要去哪里吃。后来，住在我对面的同学来找我，带我去学校附近的夜市。她说那里的东西什么都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗汤。现在我们常常一起去吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Gāoxióng lái Táiběi niàn dàxué de. Kāixué dì yī tiān, wǒ zài sùshè shéi yě bú rènshì, wǎnfàn yě bù zhīdào yào qù nǎlǐ chī. Hòulái, zhù zài wǒ duìmiàn de tóngxué lái zhǎo wǒ, dài wǒ qù xuéxiào fùjìn de yèshì. Tā shuō nàlǐ de dōngxi shénme dōu hǎochī, kěshì wǒ nà tiān zhǐ hē le yì wǎn tāng. Xiànzài wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: I came from Kaohsiung to Taipei for university. On the first day of school I knew nobody in the dorm and didn't even know where to go for dinner. Then the student living across from me came over and took me to the night market near school. She said everything there is tasty, but that day I only had a bowl of soup. Now we often have dinner together.

prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué shì cóng Gāoxióng lái de.

choices.simplified: 对面的同学觉得夜市的东西都好吃
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué juéde yèshì de dōngxi dōu hǎochī.
choices.english: The student across the hall finds all the night market food tasty.

choices.traditional: 對面的同學那天只喝了湯
choices.simplified: 对面的同学那天只喝了汤
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué nà tiān zhǐ hē le tāng.

choices.traditional: 對面的同學開學的時候誰也不認識
choices.simplified: 对面的同学开学的时候谁也不认识
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué kāixué de shíhòu shéi yě bú rènshì.
choices.english: The student across the hall knew nobody when school started.

questions.why: 她說那裡的東西什麼都好吃: the student across the hall says everything at the night market is good. Coming from Kaohsiung, knowing nobody (誰也不認識) and having only soup are all about the writer.

text.traditional: 我的鄰居是一位老太太，她一個人住。她的個性很溫柔，不但對我們很客氣，也常常做包子送給我們吃。上個星期她背疼，不能出門，我就幫她去附近的藥局買藥。她說，能有我們這樣的鄰居，她覺得很幸運。
text.simplified: 我的邻居是一位老太太，她一个人住。她的个性很温柔，不但对我们很客气，也常常做包子送给我们吃。上个星期她背疼，不能出门，我就帮她去附近的药局买药。她说，能有我们这样的邻居，她觉得很幸运。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū shì yí wèi lǎo tàitai, tā yí ge rén zhù. Tā de gèxìng hěn wēnróu, búdàn duì wǒmen hěn kèqì, yě chángcháng zuò bāozi sòng gěi wǒmen chī. Shàng ge xīngqí tā bèi téng, bù néng chūmén, wǒ jiù bāng tā qù fùjìn de yàojú mǎi yào. Tā shuō, néng yǒu wǒmen zhèyàng de línjū, tā juéde hěn xìngyùn.
text.english: My neighbor is an old lady who lives alone. She's gentle; she is not only polite to us but also often makes steamed buns for us. Last week her back hurt and she couldn't go out, so I went to a nearby pharmacy to buy medicine for her. She says she feels lucky to have neighbors like us.

prompt.traditional: 這位老太太怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这位老太太怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo tàitai zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is true of the old lady?

choices.traditional: 老太太跟家人住在一起
choices.simplified: 老太太跟家人住在一起
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai gēn jiārén zhù zài yìqǐ.
choices.english: The old lady lives with her family.

choices.traditional: 老太太常常幫鄰居買藥
choices.simplified: 老太太常常帮邻居买药
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai chángcháng bāng línjū mǎi yào.
choices.english: The old lady often buys medicine for her neighbors.

choices.pinyin: Tā de bèi chángcháng hěn téng.

choices.traditional: 老太太上個星期沒辦法出門
choices.simplified: 老太太上个星期没办法出门
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai shàng ge xīngqí méibànfǎ chūmén.
choices.english: The old lady couldn't go out last week.

questions.why: 上個星期她背疼，不能出門: last week her back kept her at home. She lives alone (一個人住), the medicine was bought for her (not by her), and it was her back that hurt, not the writer's.

text.traditional: 我家離學校很近，走路十分鐘就到了。我姐姐的公司離家很遠，她每天得先坐公車到捷運站，再坐四十分鐘的捷運，一共要一個多小時。所以姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來。週末的時候，她都在家休息，哪裡都不去。
text.simplified: 我家离学校很近，走路十分钟就到了。我姐姐的公司离家很远，她每天得先坐公车到捷运站，再坐四十分钟的捷运，一共要一个多小时。所以姐姐每天早上六点就起床了，我七点半才起来。周末的时候，她都在家休息，哪里都不去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Wǒ jiějie de gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā měi tiān děi xiān zuò gōngchē dào jiéyùn zhàn, zài zuò sìshí fēnzhōng de jiéyùn, yígòng yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Suǒyǐ jiějie měi tiān zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le, wǒ qī diǎn bàn cái qǐlái. Zhōumò de shíhòu, tā dōu zài jiā xiūxí, nǎlǐ dōu bú qù.
text.english: My home is very close to school: ten minutes on foot. My older sister's office is far from home. Every day she first takes a bus to the MRT station, then rides the MRT for forty minutes, over an hour in all. So she gets up at six every morning, while I don't get up until half past seven. On weekends she rests at home and goes nowhere.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.traditional: 姐姐的公司離她家只有十分鐘
choices.simplified: 姐姐的公司离她家只有十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie de gōngsī lí tā jiā zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's office is only ten minutes from home.

choices.traditional: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分鐘
choices.simplified: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie dào gōngsī yígòng yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's trip to work takes forty minutes in all.

choices.traditional: 姐姐每天比這個人早起床
choices.simplified: 姐姐每天比这个人早起床
choices.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān bǐ zhège rén zǎo qǐchuáng.
choices.english: The sister gets up earlier than the writer every day.

choices.traditional: 姐姐週末常常跟朋友出去玩
choices.simplified: 姐姐周末常常跟朋友出去玩
choices.pinyin: Jiějie zhōumò chángcháng gēn péngyǒu chūqù wán.
choices.english: The sister often goes out with friends on weekends.

questions.why: 姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來: six is earlier than half past seven. Ten minutes is the writer's walk to school, her whole trip (bus, then forty minutes on the MRT) is over an hour, and on weekends she stays home (哪裡都不去).
